rules.name: parameter-description
rules.description: parameter objects should have a description

rules.name: parameter-name-regex
rules.description: parameter names should match an extended RFC6570

rules.name: operation-operationId-lower-camel-case
rules.description: operationId should be in a lower camelcase format

rules.name: operation-summary-or-description
rules.description: operation should have summary or description

rules.name: operation-short-summary
rules.description: summary should be short (description can be long)

rules.name: operation-tags
rules.description: operation should have non-empty tags array

rules.name: path-keys-no-trailing-slash
rules.description: paths should not end with a slash

rules.name: server-trailing-slash
rules.description: server url should not have a trailing slash

rules.name: openapi-tags
rules.description: openapi object should have non-empty tags array

rules.name: openapi-tags-alphabetical
rules.description: openapi object should have alphabetical tags

rules.name: reference-no-other-properties
rules.description: reference objects should only have a $ref property

rules.name: pathItem-summary-or-description
rules.description: pathItem should have summary or description

rules.name: example-value-or-externalValue
rules.description: example should have either value or externalValue

rules.name: reference-components-regex
rules.description: reference components should all match spec regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9\.\-_]+

rules.name: no-script-tags-in-markdown
rules.description: markdown descriptions should not contain <script> tags
